note: CODE DERIVATION: data/gcbs_brotherton_2013.R pivots starts_with('Q') with names_to='item', so the IRW code IS the data.csv column name (Q1..Q15); live per-item 0/1/2/3/4/5 counts equal the raw columns cell for cell, 15/15. MAPPING: the data file carries no wording. Two independent ties agree 15/15: (a) codebook.txt states 'question numbers match to items in TABLE A1 of Brotherton, et. al. 2013'; (b) on the administered online form each statement sits in the same table row as <input type=radio name=Qk>, and form item k is nearest Table A1 item k by edit distance for all 15 (distance 1-7 vs next-nearest 56-81). TEXT: item_text is the administered form's wording verbatim, not Table A1's. Deviations from Table A1: every form item ends in a period; Q7 reads 'all major decisions' (A1: 'all major world decisions'); Q13 reads 'rumours' (A1: 'rumors'). The form was fetched 2026-09-25; the data were collected in 2016 and the Wayback Machine was offline, so it is not confirmed the 2016 page was identical. INSTRUCTIONS: the landing page's Procedure sentence, verbatim including its grammar ('In each questions'). The question page itself carries no instruction, only the column headers. OPTIONS: the form shows 5 radio buttons (values 1-5) headed Disagree / (blank) / Neutral / (blank) / Agree, so resp 2 and 4 have blank option_text. This differs from the paper's anchors (Definitely not true .. Definitely true), which the online version did not use. DATA NOTE: resp=0 occurs in 108 of 37,425 cells (per item Q1..Q15: 2,13,8,6,10,5,7,10,10,0,9,11,13,3,1). The form offers no 0; it is inferred to mark an item left unanswered (the codebook does not define it). Shipped with blank option_text; the processing script does not drop it as it does in other openpsychometrics tables. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv GCBS family verdict 'ship' (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R11; originator Brotherton 2013 CC BY). The register's owed check that administered items are Brotherton wording: 14/15 verbatim bar punctuation/spelling, Q7 drops one word ('world'); a trimmed CC BY item remains a CC BY adaptation, so not treated as a block. Verification: verify_gcbs_brotherton_2013.R (label tie 15/15, raw-column identity 15/15, facet block structure 13/15).
public_note: resp 0 is not a response option: it marks an item the respondent left unanswered on the online form (108 cells). The online version labelled only the ends and midpoint of its 1-5 scale (Disagree, Neutral, Agree), not the published scale's 'Definitely not true' to 'Definitely true' anchors, and item Q7 reads 'all major decisions' where the published scale has 'all major world decisions'.

note: Clean gate pass (batch_455), 80 rows = 10 items x resp 0-7; validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (10/10 items, resp set 0-7). CODE DERIVATION: pattern 1 -- data/gcbs_brotherton_2013.R selects starts_with('TIPI') and pivots by NAME, so the IRW item code IS the source column name (TIPI1..TIPI10); codebook.txt keys each column to its trait pair as a plain-text list ('TIPI1<tab>Extraverted, enthusiastic.' ...), 10/10 transcribed verbatim including trailing periods. Re-deriving from data.csv (id = row number, as the script does) reproduces the live table 24950/24950 cells; no two source columns identical (min 1797 respondents differ between any pair). instructions = the codebook's quoted administered stem 'I see myself as:' only; the TIPI's longer published preamble is not in the deposit and was deliberately not imported (terseness rule, same as machivallianism_test_tipi). item_text is the trait pair alone, as the codebook presents it. section_prompt blank, single trivial section. ANCHORS: resp 1-7 = the codebook's own seven labels ('1 = Disagree strongly' .. '7 = Agree strongly'), verbatim. RESP 0: the live table (unlike machivallianism_test_tipi, whose script filters resp != 0) keeps the deposit's 0 code, which the codebook does not document and which is by openpsychometrics convention an unanswered item: 149 cells, per item TIPI1..TIPI10 = 14/15/15/17/13/14/14/16/15/16. It gets a row with option_text blank (not padded) so the resp set joins; this is a response-data defect for the processing script, not fixed here. STORED DIRECTION: raw, not reversed -- the five canonical TIPI pairs correlate negatively excluding 0 (1x6 -0.61, 2x7 -0.30, 3x8 -0.47, 4x9 -0.64, 5x10 -0.27). RIGHTS: originator Gosling's TIPI page: 'WANT TO USE THE TIPI? GO AHEAD. ANYONE CAN USE IT FOR ANY PURPOSE. NO NEED TO ASK ME FOR PERMISSION.' -- no right reserved; same page and sha256 as batch_454 celik_2026_tipi. No register row written (rounds may not write ship rows). public_note: This table is the Ten Item Personality Inventory administered after the Generic Conspiracist Beliefs Scale in the same online session; resp 0 (149 responses, 13-17 per item) is the source file's code for an unanswered item, not a point on the 1-7 scale, and carries no label.
